claims.claim: Without neutrophils (Smillie), macrophages and other myeloid cells make most CXCL8
claims.reason: Macrophages hold 0.686 of CXCL8 transcripts; dominant lineage is myeloid.

claims.claim: the myeloid lineage replicates in all three other atlases
claims.reason: All three other atlases agree on the myeloid lineage.

claims.claim: When neutrophils are included (Gubatan), neutrophils make most of the CXCL8 transcripts
claims.reason: Neutrophil share of CXCL8 in inflamed tissue is 0.873.

claims.claim: up-regulation in all eight cohorts for CXCR2
claims.reason: Significantly up in 8 of 8 cohorts.

claims.claim: CXCR2 has Open Targets genetic support
claims.reason: Only Open Targets drug records are cited; no association or genetic score record.

claims.claim: The receptor is already drug-targeted by navarixin, ladarixin and SX-682 (phase 2) and reparixin (phase 3)
claims.reason: Drug records list reparixin phase 3 and the other three at phase 2.

claims.claim: the drugs are mostly outside UC
claims.reason: Drug records give no indication information.

claims.claim: Its transcripts sit in neutrophils in the single-cell data
claims.reason: Neutrophils account for 0.965 of CXCR2 transcripts when included.

claims.claim: CXCR2 is not replicated as a stromal or T/NK gene across atlases
claims.reason: T/NK lineage replication is false; only 1 other atlas agrees.

claims.claim: The CXCL8 to CXCR2 link from Neutrophil CXCR4 to the generic Neutrophil state rose strongly in inflamed versus uninflamed mucosa
claims.reason: Score 3213.58 inflamed vs 476.076 non-inflamed, log2 change 2.755.

claims.claim: Inflammatory fibroblasts are a stromal sender of CXCL1 to CXCR2 on neutrophils, and the link to the generic Neutrophil state rose strongly in inflamed mucosa
claims.reason: Inflammatory fibroblast to Neutrophil CXCL1-CXCR2 log2 change 3.871.

claims.claim: Absolute scores are far lower than the neutrophil CXCL8 circuit
claims.reason: The CXCL8 circuit record is not cited for this statement.

claims.claim: OSM to IL6ST from Neutrophil OSM to LP fibroblast has a low score and fell versus uninflamed mucosa
claims.reason: Score fell from 228.661 to 139.844, log2 change -0.709.

claims.claim: Only the Neutrophil PADI4 sender is new in inflamed tissue, with a small score
claims.reason: PADI4 sender absent in non-inflamed (0.0), small score 86.523 inflamed.

claims.claim: IL1B is up in all eight cohorts
claims.reason: Significantly up in 8 of 8 cohorts.

claims.claim: IL1B has drugs in Open Targets (canakinumab approved)
claims.reason: Canakinumab listed at approval stage.

claims.claim: canakinumab is approved for other diseases
claims.reason: Record gives no indication.

claims.claim: In single-cell data IL1B links go to IL1R2 on neutrophil states, sent by monocyte-derived macrophages
claims.reason: IL1B-IL1R2 pair from monocyte-derived macrophage to Neutrophil PADI4; neutrophil senders not shown.

claims.claim: IL1R2 is a decoy receptor
claims.reason: No cited record describes IL1R2 function.

claims.claim: NFkB and TNFa pathway activity are up in all eight cohorts
claims.reason: NFkB up in 8 cohorts; TNFa record also cohorts_up 8.

claims.claim: the strongest t in the NFkB pathway reaches 18.79 in GSE206285
claims.reason: 18.79 is the highest NFkB t across cohorts.

claims.claim: JAK-STAT, TGFb, EGFR, MAPK, PI3K and Hypoxia pathways are up in all eight cohorts
claims.reason: All six records show cohorts_up 8.

claims.claim: WNT is up in seven of eight cohorts (not in GSE73661)
claims.reason: WNT cohorts_up 7; GSE73661 not significant.

claims.claim: STAT3 regulon activity is up in all eight cohorts (t in GSE193677 20.6)
claims.reason: STAT3 cohorts_up 8, t 20.6 in GSE193677.

claims.claim: AP1 is also up in all eight cohorts
claims.reason: AP1 up in 8 cohorts.

claims.claim: TF activity is inferred from target genes, not from the TF mRNA
claims.reason: Record names the method (decoupler ulm) but does not state this.

claims.claim: VEGF is up in only four cohorts
claims.reason: VEGF up in 4 cohorts.

claims.claim: Androgen is down in four and up in one
claims.reason: Androgen cohorts_up 1, cohorts_down 4.
